_about: Recorded cues for tools/audio/cut_cc0.py (format from Crab Breeze, unchanged). A layer is {src: 'pack:file'} or {synth: '<gen_sfx layer or cue>'}, with optional shot (n-th shot of a multi-shot take), start, dur (s), pitch (tape-speed ratio), gain (dB after the layer is peak-normalised), lp, hp (Hz, steep), fadein, fadeout, delay (s), repeat. A cue may set len, drive (tanh), hp, lp (gentle, 12 dB/octave), distance (compressor, lowpass and reverb that push a bed into the background), loop, stereo, group, peak_db, what and edits. A cue whose what ends in (loops) loops in the game. A cue may also set scatter: a list of groups, each placing count short sounds picked from pick (layer specs) at seeded times inside within seconds (from 0, no closer than min_gap), with gain, pitch ranges and a pan width; scattered sounds are mixed after the distance treatment (this repository, 2026-11-06). A cue's lp_order (default 2, 12 dB/octave) makes its lp steeper: 4 is Crab Breeze's sealed-cockpit filter (two 2-pole passes at 4 kHz), used here for every weapon heard from the bridge through the hull, written 6 dB down (peak_db -7) (2026-11-07). A cue's hp_order (default 2) makes its hp steeper, as lp_order does its lp.

lance_fire.what: The Lance firing: a hard electric crack and a kick, a beam that snaps out and is gone in half a second.
lance_fire.edits: a crack, a laser take started at its peak and slowed to 0.85, our snap and kick, saturated, cut to 0.55 s, then heard through the hull as Crab Breeze hears outside sounds through its sealed cockpit: low passed at 4 kHz, 24 dB/octave, 6 dB down

disruptor_fire.what: A Disruptor bolt leaving its mount: a hard electric crack and a kick.
disruptor_fire.edits: slowed to 0.85 speed, cut to 0.5 s, a crack and our kick, saturated, then heard through the hull as Crab Breeze hears outside sounds through its sealed cockpit: low passed at 4 kHz, 24 dB/octave, 6 dB down

torpedo_launch.what: A Pulse torpedo leaving its tube: a deep launch thump and a short rising whine.
torpedo_launch.edits: a ship's cannon slowed and lowpassed, a phaser rise slowed to 0.6, our kick, cut to 0.9 s, then heard through the hull as Crab Breeze hears outside sounds through its sealed cockpit: low passed at 4 kHz, 24 dB/octave, 6 dB down

overload_charge.what: A mount charging in overload (loops): an electric charge building and crackling.
overload_charge.edits: trimmed to 2 s, lowpassed, crossfaded into a loop, then heard through the hull as Crab Breeze hears outside sounds through its sealed cockpit: low passed at 4 kHz, 24 dB/octave, 6 dB down

missile_launch.what: A missile away: an ignition crack and the motor roaring off.
missile_launch.edits: started at its ignition, slowed to 0.9, our kick, cut to 1.2 s, then heard through the hull as Crab Breeze hears outside sounds through its sealed cockpit: low passed at 4 kHz, 24 dB/octave, 6 dB down

pd_burst.what: Point defence firing: a short rattling burst.
pd_burst.edits: sped to 1.15, highpassed, cut to 0.5 s, then heard through the hull as Crab Breeze hears outside sounds through its sealed cockpit: low passed at 4 kHz, 24 dB/octave, 6 dB down

shield_hit.what: A shot striking a shield facing: the field absorbing it, a deep electric whump with a fizz and a crackle. An electromagnetic field: nothing in it rings.
shield_hit.edits: our field whump (noise, no tone) with an electric fizz highpassed at 1.5 kHz, a crackle and a spark; no layer that rings (owner, 2026-11-11: "IT CANNOT DING")

hull_hit.what: A shot through to the hull: a heavy metal crunch and a short blast.
hull_hit.edits: a cannonball hitting a ship slowed to 0.8 and lowpassed, a metal slam at 0.6, saturated

torpedo_detonate.what: A torpedo detonating: a blast and the energy flaring out of it.
torpedo_detonate.edits: two blasts slowed to 0.7-0.8, layered with our energy bloom

explosion_small.what: A small blast: a missile shot down, a system blown out.

ship_destroyed.what: A ship destroyed: the blast, its core going up, the hull groaning apart and a long rumble.
ship_destroyed.edits: four takes slowed to 0.5-0.8 and layered over a low rumble, the metal lowpassed

engine_hum.what: A ship's engines under way (loops): a low, steady roar.
engine_hum.edits: a rocket motor slowed to 0.7 and lowpassed, a generator under it, crossfaded into a loop

thruster_burst.what: Manoeuvring thrusters: a short hiss of a turn or a stop.
thruster_burst.edits: a boost slowed to 0.6, a slice of rocket roar

reactor_hum.what: The reactor running (loops): a deep machine hum.

shields_raise.what: Shields coming up: a rising energy swell.

shields_collapse.what: A shield facing failing: the field's energy draining away and a last deep whump as it goes. Nothing rings.
shields_collapse.edits: the electric power-down with our field whump (noise, no tone) in place of a ringing shield take

ui_clunk.what: A metal console key (the modelled skins): a switch with a heavy clunk under it.

amb_bridge.what: The bridge (loops, a minute): soft brown noise, low and even, with consoles bleeping softly now and then.
amb_bridge.edits: our brown noise kept between 60 and 600 Hz, two uncorrelated sides; the bleeps scattered softly; written at -14 dB peak; crossfaded into a loop (the owner's pick, 2026-11-07: "delete amb_bridge, use amb_bridge_brown")

shield_hit_short.what: The short shield hit, for hits that come fast: the whump and a quick fizz.
shield_hit_short.edits: the shield hit's whump and fizz cut short; no layer that rings

hull_hit_short.what: The short hull hit, for hits that come fast: the metal crunch without the blast's tail.
hull_hit_short.edits: the layers of hull_hit, each cut short and faded, to 0.6 s

torpedo_detonate_short.what: The short torpedo detonation: the blast and its flare, without the long fall.
torpedo_detonate_short.edits: the layers of torpedo_detonate, each cut short and faded, to 1.1 s

explosion_small_short.what: The short small blast: a missile shot down, a system blown out, quickly.
explosion_small_short.edits: the layers of explosion_small, each cut short and faded, to 0.7 s

red_alert.what: Battle stations (loops): a ship's whooping klaxon rising through the corridors, every 2.6 s.
red_alert.edits: a recorded whoop klaxon slowed to 0.9, given a room, crossfaded into a loop

red_alert_twotone.what: Battle stations, alternative (loops): a two-tone alarm, high and low.

red_alert_wail.what: Battle stations, alternative (loops): a rising siren wail, three times every 2.1 s.
red_alert_wail.edits: three wails cut from a siren, crossfaded into a loop
